title: EKU check against certificate type
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, A.2 Extended Key Usage Identifiers. HCERT Specification, A.2 Extended Key Usage Identifiers: “If one or more are present, the verifiers SHALL verify the key usage against the stored HCERT.”.

statements.label: EKU check against certificate type
statements.requirement: If the matching DSC has an Extended Key Usage extension with any of 1.3.6.1.4.1.1847.2021.1.1 (test), .1.2 (vaccinations) or .1.3 (recovery), the verifier SHALL check it against the certificate type of the payload: DVC (-6) and DDCC VS (3) are vaccinations, DDCC TR (4) is test, and a DCC (1) is the type of its single v, t or r entry. A DSC with no such extension SHALL be accepted for any type.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-VER-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-VER-004 a DSC whose key usage allows test certificates only cannot sign a vaccination` (VerifyTest.kt); `STT-VER-004 a DCC is a test, vaccination or recovery certificate by its own entry` (VerifyTest.kt)).
